in_marathi.name: Manotosh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manotosh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manas (mind) + Tosh (intelligence, wisdom). This name is derived from the Sanskrit words Manas (mind) and Tosh (intelligence, wisdom). The name Manotosh signifies the one who has an excellent mind and intelligence.
